_note: Course catalogue. 'skills' maps a course to the skill ids it closes; recommendations are chosen by matching a course's skills to the student's ranked gaps. Every entry points at a real, free, externally hosted resource (IndiaBix, GeeksforGeeks, Khan Academy, NPTEL, NeetCode, Coursera audit, Tech Interview Handbook) - swap in your own LMS links if you have them.
